- Trace schema & sampling defaults
- Pilot success criteria (latency, token-attribution accuracy, privacy filters)
- Next steps: test data, SSO for staging, and SOW signoff

Pre-kickoff asks (attached):
- Draft trace hook spec (trace-hook-spec.md) — review and flag any fields you can’t send (PII concerns)
- SOW draft (llmtoolkit-integration-sow-v1.pdf) — includes pilot scope and optional post-pilot pricing

Can you confirm:
1) Tech lead who will join the kickoff (email)
2) Any data restrictions (sampling % or fields to redact)
3) Preferred times Thu/Fri PST for a 30-min slot?

If OK, Marissa will run the commercial side and Aditya will loop in legal for a quick DocuSign flow.

Thanks,

Kimberly — thanks, this looks great. Ngoc (our engineering lead) is cc'd and can join the kickoff. A few quick questions before we lock a time:

- KV cache / context: will Redwood need full prompt + metadata or can we configure prefixes only? We need to avoid sending PII from our user prompts.
- Sampling: we typically sample 5% of production traces for telemetry; for the pilot we'd prefer a fixed test stream, but would like to understand the overhead if we ramp to 25% later.
- SOW: the pricing line for "pilot professional services" — can you confirm hourly cap? Legal will want that in the redline.

Available times (PST): Thu 12/21 10:00–12:00 or Fri 12/22 09:00–11:00.

Also, we have a compliance checklist item: TLS mutual auth between FieldTrace staging and Redwood ingest. Is that supported?

Appreciate it —
Liam

Hi Liam / Kim,

Quick answers to the items Liam raised:
- PII & KV cache: Redwood can be configured to only accept explicit prefixes or metadata fields — we don't require full prompt text for attribution. We'll add an ingestion filter so your team can redact fields before they arrive.
- Sampling: pilot = fixed test stream (no sampling). If you scale to 25% we recommend a staged ramp with our sampling controller; overhead is typically <3% CPU on our runtime for trace ingestion. We'll include the telemetry cost assumptions in the SOW appendix.
- TLS mutual auth: supported. We'll share cert-exchange instructions in the kickoff.
- Pricing: pilot professional services capped at 40 hours (as written in the SOW). If you'd like a different cap, tell us and we can update the redline.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm Thu 12/21 10:30 PST for a 30-min kickoff — Kim/Ngoc to share calendar invites.
2) Liam to confirm any fields you absolutely cannot send (we'll mark them in the trace-hook spec).
3) Aditya will route the SOW to legal for DocuSign; if you send redlines we can incorporate them ahead of kickoff.

Legal/commercial note: if you send redlines, please use the Document Comments feature so our counsel can track changes more easily.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.
—Marissa
